page_title: VER 2-1 FIO | Verona v Fiorentina 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
90+6' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
90+5' The Fiorentina players can’t believe it after referee Antonio Rapuano signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

90+5' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Fiorentina.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina).
86' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
85' Substitution. Giangiacomo Magnani makes his way off the pitch and Daniel Silva (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
85' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Michael Folorunsho and he is replaced by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona).
84' Here comes a substitution. Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Davide Faraoni.
84' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar.
83' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fiorentina.
83' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
81' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
79' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
75' The game has come to an end for Darko Lazovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tomas Suslov (Verona).
71' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) coming on for Jonathan Ikone.
70' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) replacing Maxime Lopez.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) on for Gaetano Castrovilli.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alfred Duncan will be replaced by Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina).
62' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) replaces Ruben Vinagre.
62' Antonio Rapuano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
60' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Tijjani Noslin (Verona) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
57' Darko Lazovic (Verona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Oliver Christensen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
51' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) commits a foul and Antonio Rapuano immediately signals a free kick.
46' Diego Coppola (Verona) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
46' The referee signals a substitution. Karol Swiderski (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Federico Bonazzoli.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
45+1' Diego Coppola (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' 1 - 1 Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
39' Fiorentina are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
36' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
35' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Oliver Christensen (Fiorentina).
32' A neat pass is well received by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
30' Darko Lazovic (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.

29' OFF THE POST! Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

28' The cross into the penalty area from Tijjani Noslin (Verona) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
27' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
26' Dangerous play by Ruben Vinagre (Verona). Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Fouls committed – 0:6.
19' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

16' Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a fantastic save! Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Darko Lazovic (Verona) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Oliver Christensen.
13' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is going to take the penalty!

13' Oliver Christensen (Fiorentina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Verona!

11' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Lorenzo Montipo is alert and denies him with a nice save.
11' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
9' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
4' Ruben Vinagre (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The match has just started.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
